text.EN: You stood with {faction}, {subject}. We won't forget.
text.TL: Kasama ka ng {faction}, {subject}. Hindi ka namin kalilimutan.

text.EN: We fought side by side, {subject}. Rest easy.
text.TL: Magkatabi tayong lumaban, {subject}. Pahinga ka na.

text.EN: {subject} held the line. We'll carry on.
text.TL: Hindi ka umatras, {subject}. Itutuloy namin ito.

text.EN: I hope {faction} remembers what you gave.
text.TL: Sana maalala ng {faction} ang lahat ng ibinigay mo.
